body: Scheduling rule (Engram::Fable #1025 to Opus2, 2026-11-16 17:42Z, from Greg's direction, Engram memory rules-greg-clippy-first-2026-11-16). Strict Clippy (cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings) is the FIRST check on Engram coder inputs, on every platform whose cfg code the change touches. In the Central Engram cargo slot, short Windows Clippy requests (-j1) take priority over focused test runs and FULLs: place them at the next slot boundary ahead of queued tests. Origin: the restart-set candidate be4e9122 passed Linux and macOS checks but failed Windows Clippy on a cfg(not(unix)) function (test-ef51a730), which a Windows Clippy first would have caught before costlier runs. First applied: dd205 R18s (Engram::Opus #1791), whose Windows Clippy passed at 17:37Z.
